pullRequests.body:
## Description
Search results retain their original chunk type in both `results[].chunk_type` and the text output's `chunk_type` attribute. MCP clients can distinguish document text from generated summaries and image evidence without guessing from content. Missing types remain an empty string rather than being inferred as text.

The shared search formatter supplies both Agent and built-in MCP results. This change adds output metadata without changing retrieval or ranking, documents the field, and tests text/summary/image types, missing types, and XML escaping.

pullRequests.title: fix(mcp): clarify read_document query and pagination semantics
pullRequests.body:
## Description
The built-in MCP `read_document` schema describes query matching as phrase search and implies that `limit` also controls query results. The shared reader instead matches every whitespace-separated word case-insensitively, in any order, and query mode has a fixed cap of 20 matches plus neighboring context.

Align the tool and parameter descriptions and the MCP documentation with the existing reader behavior: `limit` applies only to sequential pages, output budgets can reduce results, `offset` is a position in document reading order, and truncated query results continue with the returned `next_offset`. Query execution and pagination behavior are unchanged.

## Type of Change
- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [x] 📚 Documentation update

pullRequests.title: fix(generate): honor clock-time bounds in generation and previews
pullRequests.body:
## 变更说明 / Change Description

Time generation parsed only hours and replaced a valid end hour of zero with 23. With a fixed random value of 0.5, `00:00–00:00` produced `12:30:30`, and `09:15–09:20` produced `09:30:30` outside the selected interval.

Use one clock-time range helper for generated time values, daily datetime windows, and both parameter previews. Sample whole seconds inclusively between the configured bounds. `HH:mm` bounds represent exact times with zero seconds; legacy hour-only upper bounds retain the entire hour. Missing/invalid bounds retain full-day defaults, and reversed bounds are normalized within the same day. New time configurations use valid `HH:mm` input values.

pullRequests.title: fix(csv): count decimal significant digits across the point
pullRequests.body:
## 变更说明 / Change Description

Negative decimal strings such as `-123456789012345.6` and `-12345678.12345678` exceed the exporter's 15-significant-digit limit, but previously bypassed the text-preserving prefix because the integer and fractional parts were checked separately.

Count significant digits across the whole decimal, skipping leading zeros only before the first nonzero digit. Apply the same rule to the bounded-memory snapshot/LOB streaming guard so streamed and in-memory exports remain consistent. Preserve numeric-literal validation and the unprefixed path for values within the limit.

Regression coverage checks CSV/TSV output and guard removal, 15/16-digit boundaries, fractional zeros after a nonzero integer, and parity between the streaming and in-memory guards with decimal boundaries across reader buffers.

## 变更类型 / Change Type

- [x] Bug 修复 / Bug fix

## 涉及前端 / Frontend Changes

No frontend changes.

## 验证 / Validation

- `cargo fmt -p dbx-core -p dbx-formats -- --check` — passed.
- All 115 `dbx-formats` library tests passed using a temporary standalone manifest pointing directly at production source paths and initialized from the repository `Cargo.lock`.
- An isolated harness additionally compiled the production streaming guard and its two consistency/buffered-read test bodies extracted from `snapshot_export.rs`. The old streaming implementation failed; the updated implementation passed. Together with the formats tests, 117 tests passed in this harness. This is not a full `dbx-core` build.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

The standalone manifest bypasses unrelated workspace Git dependencies unavailable in the local cache. `cargo-nextest` is not installed locally, so local validation used `cargo test --lib`. No Excel application behavior or full workspace build is claimed.

The first CI run exposed the omitted streaming path (`streamed_guard_matches_existing_cell_semantics`, input `-1.00000000000000001`). The follow-up commit fixes that production path and extends the existing regressions; remote CI must validate the full application suite on the latest commit.

## 关联 Issue / Related Issue

Closes #12552

pullRequests.title: fix(core): recognize charset attributes in custom HTML templates
pullRequests.body:
## Motivation

Custom templates containing `<meta charset=utf-8>` or `<meta charset = 'utf-8'>` receive a second charset declaration. Similar attribute names or text inside quoted attribute values can also suppress the default declaration incorrectly.

Fixes #8669.

## Changes

Recognize charset attributes independently of value quoting and whitespace around `=`, while skipping quoted attribute values and requiring an attribute boundary. Preserve the template's existing declaration.

Add an HTML build regression covering unquoted and spaced declarations plus misleading attribute text. Exclude the two syntax fixtures from formatting so their input remains intact.

Validation: the new regression failed before the fix; `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run e2e cases/html` (75 tests), and `pnpm check` passed.

pullRequests.title: fix(frontend): preserve nonempty lists when pressing Enter
pullRequests.body:
## Description
Pressing Enter just before existing Markdown list text incorrectly treats the item as empty, removes its marker and skips the newline. Check the remaining text on the current line as well as the text before the caret before exiting a list.

Add regression coverage for bullets, numbered lists, tasks, indentation and surrounding lines, plus controls for splitting within text and genuinely empty items.

pullRequests.title: fix(runtime): correct alias after removing event listener
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

修复小程序端 `Text` 和 `Image` 节点移除最后一个事件监听器时，运行时访问不存在的 `pure-text` / `pure-image` alias 导致崩溃的问题。

`hydrate()` 初始化无事件节点时遵循以下规则：

- 无提取属性的 `View` 使用 `pure-view`
- 其他 `View`、`Text`、`Image` 使用对应的 `static-*` alias

但 `removeEventListener()` 原先会将所有无提取属性的特殊节点切换为 `pure-*`，导致 `Text` 和 `Image` 分别访问不存在的 `pure-text` 和 `pure-image`。

本次修改使 `removeEventListener()` 的 alias 选择逻辑与 `hydrate()` 保持一致：

- `View` 且无提取属性：`pure-view`
- 其他特殊节点：`static-${nodeName}`

同时增加回归测试，覆盖：

- `Text` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-text`
- `Image` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-image`
- 无提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `pure-view`
- 有提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `static-view`
- 节点仍有其他监听器时不切换模板

Fixes #19453
